people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

translations.web: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),
translations.bsb: And at that time Eli, whose eyesight had grown so dim that he could not see, was lying in his room.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see;
